serverInfo.name: zereight-gitlab-mcp-server
serverInfo.description: GitLab MCP server for projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more.

tools.name: get_merge_request_approval_state
tools.description: Get merge request approval details including approvers. Inspect approval rules and approvers before merging. Use `approve_merge_request` to change approval state.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search for GitLab projects. If the identifier is known, use a typed get or list tool.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get contents of a file or directory from a GitLab project.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue. Open a new issue. Use `update_issue` for an existing issue and `create_issue_note` for discussion.

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a new merge request. Open a merge request from an existing source branch to a target. Use `update_merge_request` after it exists.

tools.name: get_branch
tools.description: Get branch details (commit, protection status). To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches in project with search filter. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: get_merge_request
tools.description: Get details of a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). Set include_summaries=true for deployment/commit/approval summaries. To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

tools.name: get_merge_request_diffs
tools.description: Get the changes/diffs of a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

tools.name: list_merge_request_changed_files
tools.description: List changed file paths in a merge request without diff content (merge_request_iid or source_branch required).

tools.name: list_merge_request_diffs
tools.description: List merge request diffs with pagination (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: get_merge_request_file_diff
tools.description: Get diffs for specific files from a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required).

tools.name: update_merge_request
tools.description: Update a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). Use the create tool for new resources and a note tool for comments.

tools.name: create_merge_request_thread
tools.description: Create a new thread on a merge request. Start a review thread. Use `create_merge_request_note` for an unthreaded note and `create_merge_request_discussion_note` to reply.

tools.name: resolve_merge_request_thread
tools.description: Resolve a thread on a merge request. Mark an existing review thread resolved. Use `update_merge_request_discussion_note` to change note text.

tools.name: mr_discussions
tools.description: List discussion items for a merge request. List complete discussion threads. Use `get_merge_request_notes` for flat notes.

tools.name: get_merge_request_discussion
tools.description: Get a single discussion item for a merge request. Fetch one discussion by id. Use `mr_discussions` for a collection and `get_merge_request_note` for a flat note.

tools.name: get_merge_request_note
tools.description: Get a specific note for a merge request. Fetch one note by id. Use `get_merge_request_notes` for a collection and `mr_discussions` for threads.

tools.name: get_merge_request_notes
tools.description: List notes for a merge request. List flat notes. Use `mr_discussions` when thread structure and resolution state are required.

tools.name: create_issue_note
tools.description: Add a note to an issue, optionally replying to a discussion thread. Add a note to an existing issue, optionally as a reply. Use `update_issue` for issue fields.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues (default: created by current user; use scope='all' for all). Use this for issue management: list GitLab issues, optionally scoped with `project_id`. Use `get_issue` when the iid is known and `my_issues` for the current user's assignments.

tools.name: my_issues
tools.description: List issues assigned to the authenticated user. Use this for issue management: list issues assigned to the authenticated user. Use `list_issues` for project-wide listing and `get_issue` for one issue. Requires classic read_user or fine-grained User:Read.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue. Returns the issue with a slim nested milestone by default; set full_response=true for the complete milestone object. Use this for issue management: inspect one issue. Use `list_issues` or `my_issues` to discover issues first.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue. Returns a slim confirmation by default; set full_response=true for the complete updated issue object. Change fields on an existing issue. Use `update_issue_description_patch` for a targeted description edit and `create_issue_note` for discussion.

tools.name: update_issue_description_patch
tools.description: Apply a patch (search/replace or unified diff) to an issue description. Reduces token usage by allowing small changes without sending the full description. Supports dry_run to preview changes and create_note to summarize updates.

tools.name: list_issue_discussions
tools.description: List discussions for an issue. List threaded discussions for an issue. Use `list_issues` or `get_issue` for issue records.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get details of a specific project. To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects accessible by the current user. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: List members of a GitLab project. Search project members by name or username. Use `list_group_members` for a group.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List labels for a project. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: get_repository_tree
tools.description: List files and directories in a repository.

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: List merge requests (without project_id: user's MRs; with project_id: project MRs). For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Get current authenticated user details. Requires classic read_user or fine-grained User:Read. Use `get_user` or `get_users` to look up another user.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List repository commits with filtering options. For one known resource, use the matching get tool.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get details of a specific commit. To find resources, use the matching list or search tool.

tools.name: get_commit_diff
tools.description: Get changes/diffs of a specific commit. Return the file diffs for one commit. Use `get_commit` for metadata without the patch.

tools.name: get_file_blame
tools.description: Get git blame for a file at a given ref. Each entry maps a contiguous range of source lines to the commit that last changed them (id, author, authored_date, message). Use range_start/range_end to limit blame to specific lines.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify server status and authentication. Always reports the MCP server version (mcp_server_version). When authenticated, also reports the GitLab instance version from GET /api/v4/version (version, revision, enterprise). Version lookup failures do not fail the health check  -  those fields are omitted.

tools.name: discover_tools
tools.description: Discover and activate additional tool categories for this session. Available categories: core, merge_requests, issues, repositories, branches, projects, labels, ci, groups, pipelines, milestones, wiki, releases, tags, snippets, users, workitems, webhooks, search, variables, dependency_proxy, vulnerabilities, orbit. Already-active categories are listed in the response. Explicit-only toolsets are omitted; list them in GITLAB_TOOLSETS.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Return a short GitLab workflow guide. Omit topic for the overview and topic list. Use this for a short workflow guide (code-review, pipelines, issues, token-saving). Omit topic for the overview. Detailed GitLab operations stay on the typed tools.
